parameters.text:
Hi,

The Facebook Like bot was not logged in (or not running) at {{ $now.setZone('Asia/Kolkata').toFormat('dd LLL yyyy, hh:mm a') }}.
No likes were given to the scheduled groups.

How to fix:
1. Open WSL and run: pm2 status  (fb-groups-like-bot should be 'online'; if not: pm2 restart fb-groups-like-bot)
2. See what Facebook is showing: http://localhost:3005/screen.png?key=change-me-secret
3. Log in again:
   Option A: pm2 stop fb-groups-like-bot, then: HEADLESS=false node server.js -> log in -> Ctrl+C -> pm2 start fb-groups-like-bot
   Option B: export fresh cookies with Cookie-Editor and POST them to http://localhost:3005/cookies
4. Confirm at http://localhost:3005/status?key=change-me-secret
5. Re-run the workflow in n8n.

Details: {{ JSON.stringify($json) }}
